parent_objective: implement bounded fixed-policy source trace runner after M1510 design
blocked_by: source traces must be collected before measured T4/T5 candidate materialization can be audited
supersedes: manual or broad rollout generation without source-family caps

public_gates: M1511 must implement bounded source trace runner
M1511 must run fixed public checkpoint only
M1511 must attempt all six source families with a small source-family cap
M1511 must write trace snapshot summary and guardrail artifacts
M1511 must not materialize candidates or export a training corpus
M1511 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or alter actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run broad rollout generation
do not claim self-identification from trace collection

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements a bounded public fixed-policy source trace runner and smoke after M1510 design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: runner implementation and public source-trace plumbing only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if checkpoint cannot load under the P0 actor contract
stop if all source families fail before decision step
stop if runner needs private holdout or broad rollouts to pass
stop if implementation would materialize candidates or export a training corpus
fallback_plan: if checkpoint loading fails, route to checkpoint compatibility audit
if source families fail before reset or reveal, route to env-hook repair
if source families run but not to decision, route to bounded runner audit before candidate materialization

admission_evidence: M1510 design fixes checkpoint runner budget schema and guardrails
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up trace audit or blocker manifest
next_stage_criteria: next audit or blocker is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1511 collects source traces only; it must not claim that any history window is necessary.
history_necessity_tests: trace rows must preserve reveal decision and post-decision windows for later T4/T5 materialization
no intervention outcome can be claimed until a later measured-candidate audit
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: bounded public fixed-policy source traces from default_hook_specs(seed_count=1).
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If traces do not reach reveal or decision, record explicit failure rows and route to audit or env-hook repair instead of broadening the run.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded fixed-policy runner can collect public source traces for the six decisive-history source families without training or candidate materialization.
success_criteria: runner attempts all six source families with max_rollout_steps 96
trace snapshot summary and guardrail artifacts are written
candidate_materialized training replay PPO promotion private holdout and actor-input changes remain false
failure_criteria: runner module or tests are missing
checkpoint loading or actor-contract assertion is ambiguous
runner does not write failure rows for incomplete source traces
candidate materialization corpus export training PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1511 passes if a bounded fixed-policy runner collects source trace artifacts with all guardrails false and no candidate materialization.
